claim: Michigan MDARD awarded regenerative value-chain grants supporting infrastructure and market development beyond on-farm practice.
verifiedFacts: MDARD announced the grant recipients on September 29, 2026.
Awards support infrastructure, marketing and market opportunities for regenerative agriculture products.
inference: Adoption requires supply-chain and demand-side support, not only field technique.
This is a concrete buyer/value-chain problem suitable for service mapping rather than a new standalone software product.
significance: Medium-high: regenerative adoption is being funded as a value-chain coordination problem.
assumptions: Grant-funded work will be implemented as described.
knownLimitations: Awards are not evidence of sustained demand, margins or ecological outcomes.
